standards.label: Preservation
standards.description: Preservation standards heading and the three guarantee cards
standards.title: Permanent Indexing & Open Access Guarantees
standards.subtitle: PRESERVATION STANDARDS
standards.content: Every volume is kept permanently available with stable citation metadata and author-retained copyright.

cards.title: Open Access & CC BY 4.0
cards.text: Articles are freely and immediately available worldwide without subscriptions or embargoes. Authors retain copyright in full.

cards.title: Persistent DOI Archiving
cards.text: Published articles receive a persistent Digital Object Identifier so every citation keeps resolving to the version of record.

cards.title: Double-Blind Peer Review
cards.text: All articles undergo double-blind assessment by independent disciplinary experts before inclusion in a published issue.

cta.content: Submissions are invited across health sciences, clinical medicine, pharmacy, agriculture, law, computing, and social welfare for the next biannual issue.

meta.contactText: Proposing a thematic special issue or looking for a past volume? Contact the editorial staff directly.
